name: Samui Airport

runway.v: one runway, 17/35, 2,100 m long and 45 m wide

customs.v: customs and immigration within aerodrome hours

curfew.v: closed outside 06:00–22:00 local; marginally compliant Chapter 3 jets may not take off or land 18:00–06:59 local
curfew.quote: will be prohibited for take-off and landing at Samui Airport between 1100 UTC and 2359 UTC.

noise.v: Chapter 2 jets not allowed; NADP 1 take-offs; APU use kept to a minimum
noise.quote: Aircraft with Chapter 2 noise certification are not permitted to operate.

handling.v: ground handling by Bangkok Airways Ground Services (PGGS)
handling.quote: Bangkok Airways Ground Services Co., Ltd (PGGS)

slots.v: Level 3 (coordinated) airport under Thai slot rules; non-scheduled flights must obtain slots
slots.quote: Applicants requesting approval for non-scheduled flight permission must obtain slots for Level 2 and Level 3 Airport.

ppr.v: non-scheduled flights need a flight permit from CAAT's Flight Permit Division, applied for at least 3 business days ahead
ppr.quote: The application must be submitted to the Flight Permit Division at least three (3) business days in advance

missing: how far ahead slots must be requested
notes: AIP times are UTC; local = UTC+7, no daylight saving. Closure window derived from AD hours 2300-1500 UTC. The 18:00-06:59 local ban applies only to marginally compliant Chapter 3 jets (cumulative margin 5 EPNdB or less), with medical/humanitarian exemptions. Runway TORA is shorter than runway length (RWY 17 1,800 m, RWY 35 1,900 m). Read from the 23 Jan 2025 AIRAC (location wording from 13 Jun 2024); newer packages could not be opened. AIP lists www.samuiairport.com as the airport URL (not read).
